# Copilot Instructions

- Read `docs/architecture.md` before architectural changes and follow `docs/rules.md` for all work.
- Respect `docs/prd.md` when implementing product features; distinguish verified behavior from assumptions.
- Update `docs/tasks.md` when completing work or discovering bugs/tasks.
- Inspect existing dependencies and utilities before proposing or installing packages.
- Avoid unnecessary rewrites, new patterns, and unrelated file changes.
- Work incrementally: make a focused change, validate it, then continue.
- Explain important changes, consequences, tradeoffs, and any unverified behavior.
- Never expose secrets or make unsupported privacy, security, or mental-health claims.
